# Ascend Consulting

> Ascend Consulting is a strategic marketing and growth consultancy founded by Brad Stave, based in Tacoma, WA. We help nonprofits, technology companies, and growth-stage businesses build stronger brands, communicate with clarity, and grow with measurable, AI-optimized marketing systems.

Ascend Consulting delivers six core service lines — Growth Marketing Strategy, Brand Alignment & Storytelling, Sales Enablement, Lifecycle Marketing Systems, Digital Acquisition & Growth, and Creative Design & Content Development — plus BrandRise™, a packaged brand-launch system for organizations that need to build or relaunch their brand, website, and marketing presence.

## Solutions

- [BrandRise™](https://www.ascendsmartly.com/brandrise): Complete brand launch/relaunch packages, four upfront tiers starting at $3,500 or $250/month with no upfront cost.
- [Industry Solutions](https://www.ascendsmartly.com/industry): Marketing systems for legal and accounting/finance firms.
- [Exit-Ready Brand](https://www.ascendsmartly.com/exit-ready-brand): Brand and marketing readiness for organizations preparing to sell.
- [Real Estate Marketing](https://www.ascendsmartly.com/real-estate-marketing): Listing marketing systems for real estate agents.
